lines.zh: 我四条短腿跑起来，沙往后飞。
lines.en: My four short legs get going and the sand flies back.
The frill at my neck sways as I walk.
I keep to the dune's slope.

lines.zh: 我低头，在干河床上找种子。
lines.en: I lower my head to look for seeds in the dry bed.
My beak is hard enough to bite through roots.

lines.zh: 我从一块石头后绕出来。
lines.en: I come around from behind a stone.
In sand my feet only sink a little.
I stop at every step and check around.
I walk behind my herd-mates.
My tail hangs low and sweeps the sand.

lines.zh: 我从干枯的灌木边过去。
lines.en: I pass the dry shrubs.

lines.zh: 我抬起前腿，踩上一块石头。
lines.en: I lift a foreleg onto a stone.
The sun's too strong. I head for shade.

lines.zh: 我一边走，一边注意天上。
lines.en: I walk and keep an eye on the sky.
I stand in the sand without moving.
My frill is meant to be seen.
I lower my head and take a bite of dry grass.

lines.zh: 我把蛋往沙里埋深一点。
lines.en: I bury the eggs a little deeper in the sand.
A few young ones are behind me.
I put them on the sheltered side.
Sand carries sound. I listen.
Something's flying in the distance.
I hold still and see where it goes.
There aren't many seeds here.

lines.zh: 我的喙在石头上磨了磨。
lines.en: I rub my beak on a stone.
The dune shadows have lengthened.

lines.zh: 天快黑了，我才活跃起来。
lines.en: It's nearly dark. Now I come alive.
I turn slowly to see behind me.

lines.zh: 我用后腿刨沙，把身子埋低。
lines.en: I kick sand back with my hind legs and settle lower.
One of the herd is making a soft call.
You've stepped on my dune.
I turn my frill toward you.

lines.zh: 我把小的挡在两条后腿间。
lines.en: I tuck the little ones between my hind legs.

lines.zh: 我脖子上的壳，比看上去硬。
lines.en: This frill is harder than it looks.
You're watching. So am I.
I have young ones behind me. Don't blame me.

lines.zh: 夜里我护着蛋，你别过来。
lines.en: At night I guard the eggs; stay back.

lines.zh: 我的喙，能咬断你的手指。
lines.en: My beak could take a finger off.

lines.zh: 我的鼻孔一张一合，盯着你。
lines.en: My nostrils flare as I stare at you.
You were the one who moved first.

lines.zh: 你靴子上有沙，我闻到了。
lines.en: There is sand on your boots; I smell it.
Next time, not from that side.
The blow landed at the edge of my frill.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，颈盾还举着。
lines.en: I give half a step, frill still up.
Blood drips on the sand and is drunk up.
There's a print in the sand. I'll remember.

lines.zh: 群里挤上来，把我护在中间。
lines.en: The herd crowds in and shields me at the centre.
My hind legs buckle and I nearly kneel.
I back slowly toward the herd.
Sand in the wound. It stings.
I make a low sound.
I turn away toward the far side of the dune.
You've got something green in your hand.
I stretch my neck and sniff.
Leaves? Rare here.
I take one step, then stop.
Put it down.
I'll come and get it myself.
My beak takes it, still wet.
I'll take some back for the young.
Any more? Just a little.
Once this bite's done, I'm leaving.
You hit my frill.

lines.zh: 一圈同伴围上来，挤歪了我。
lines.en: The herd pressed in and shoved me off my line.
That should hurt your hand.
I lower my head and make a low sound.

lines.zh: 我的颈盾撞在你膝盖上。
lines.en: My frill bangs against your knee.
I back half a step and sand kicks up.
The herd closes in. We fight together.

lines.zh: 几只一起顶，把你推回去。
lines.en: Several of us push and drive you back.
My beak scrapes the back of your hand.
This sand is ours.
My kind are on the far side of the dune.
First we size each other up by our frills.
Its frill is a little wider than mine.

lines.zh: 我们绕着对方转了半圈。
lines.en: We circle each other halfway.
It lowers its head, and so do I.

lines.zh: 巢挖在沙丘背风的一侧。
lines.en: The nest goes on the dune's sheltered side.
The eggs go into the warm sand.
We take turns lying over them.

lines.zh: 有东西来，我们会一起冲。
lines.en: If something comes, we charge together.

lines.zh: 小的出来，也在这个群里。
lines.en: The young will join this herd.
I grip with my beak and pull up.
This grass is very dry.

lines.zh: 我把种子从壳里嗑出来。
lines.en: I crack the seeds out of their husks.
This will take me a while to chew.
I hold this seed in my beak.
I bite through the root and eat slowly.
This handful isn't filling.
I'll take it back to the herd.
Let the young have this mouthful first.
I eat what's left.
The sand is moving over there.
My neck frill is up.
It's alive, coming this way.
The young are behind me.
The young are behind me. I can't retreat.
I turn my frill to face it.
The herd-mates turn too.
We stand in a line.
There are more of us than it.
It's standing there, hesitating.
That's our chance.

lines.zh: 我抬脚，往前挪了一小段。
lines.en: I lift a foot and edge forward a little.
The whole herd moves.
It's given ground to the stones.
We follow it, not far.
It circles us.

lines.zh: 我们跟着转，一直对着它。
lines.en: We turn with it, always facing.
The young stay in the middle.
It's tried twice.
Twice it's been turned back.
My beak caught its leg.
It cried out.
It's backed off a dozen paces.
We crowd it outward.
We don't chase past this sand.
The sand is held.
I look back at the young.
Not one missing.
I lower my head and go back to eating.
I lower my head and charge, frill first.
That knocks it off balance.
I bite with my beak.
A herd-mate hits it from the side.
It kicks me and I give half a step.
I charge again.
Sand flies everywhere.
I've got its leg in my beak.
It throws me off and runs.
We stand in a ring, breathing hard.
No one is hurt.
The young are still in the middle.

lines.zh: 它踩了我一脚，我咬着不放。
lines.en: It stamped on me and I held on.

lines.zh: 我的颈盾撞出很大一声。
lines.en: My frill hits with a loud crack.
I push up out of the dune.
Dry here. Just right.
First I lower my head to look for food.
Sand grinds against my beak.
There's a dry riverbed in the distance.
This frill blocks wind and teeth alike.
No water underfoot, only sand.
It's nearly dark. Time to come out.
This is when I come out.
I hear the herd calling.
They're over there.
I run toward the calling.
My frill is paler than theirs.
They let me stand in the middle.
The young circle me.
This herd is mine tonight.
Let me look around first.
This dune is dry, just right for me.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的颈盾，我打转。
lines.en: Fire catches my frill and I spin about.

lines.zh: 我从沙丘上滚下去，摔得发闷。
lines.en: I roll down the dune and land hard.

lines.zh: 水到了我的喙，我抬不起头。
lines.en: Water reaches my beak and I can't lift my head.

lines.zh: 炸响把沙掀起来，我被埋了半截。
lines.en: A blast throws up sand and half buries me.

lines.zh: 一支箭扎进我的颈盾，卡住了。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my frill.
A force presses me into the sand.

lines.zh: 沙里什么都没有，我饿得发晕。
lines.en: Nothing in the sand. Hunger makes me dizzy.

lines.zh: 雷打在我背上，我四条腿都僵了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes my back and all four legs lock.

lines.zh: 没有沙，没有地，我一直在掉。
lines.en: No sand, no ground. I keep falling.
